actions.exact_result_status: Amazon announced a $5 billion Fayette County first site within its $10 billion Ohio investment; no local vote was stated.
actions.access_caveat: Company source; not a local approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA construction permit 4GC10374*BG issued for Amazon Data Services, Fayette County/Jefferson Township Site B, with 196.16 acres of land disturbance.
actions.access_caveat: Official statewide permit list; it is land-disturbance authorization, not a building permit or local zoning vote.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA construction permit 4GC10679*AG issued for Amazon Data Services S.R. 435/S.R. 739 improvements in Jeffersonville, 1.041 acres.
actions.access_caveat: Roadwork permit; separate from building construction.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records AES Ohio Fayette Sub Expansion, 37.2 acres, at Fent Road, supporting the site's power infrastructure; this is a utility/land-disturbance action, not a data-center building permit.
actions.access_caveat: Utility-support permit; no PUCO interconnection approval was located in this pass.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records AES Ohio Fayette Substation, 7.1 acres, at Fent Road, Jefferson Township.
actions.access_caveat: Substation land-disturbance permit; not an interconnection approval or building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA issued permit 4GC10816*AG for Project Galaxy Force Main for Cooling Water Discharge, Amazon Data Services, at 1000 Innovation Way, 11.3 acres.
actions.access_caveat: Cooling-water force-main land-disturbance permit; it is not a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA granted Section 401 Water Quality Certification for CMH205 Data Center, Amazon Data Services, Fayette County/Jeffersonville, subject to conditions; the authorization is limited to water pollution and does not replace other permits.
actions.access_caveat: Official Ohio EPA certification; it is an environmental authorization, not local zoning/building approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records Amazon Fayette County/Jefferson Township Site A Phase 1A, 330 acres of land disturbance.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit list; no building occupancy or energization follows from this permit alone.
